purpose: The machine-readable product contract: the single in-repo authority for the facts CI gates check — the feature delivery matrix, the telemetry planes, the size of the verification net, and the proofs deliberately parked. Gates read THIS file, never a planning document, so the contract ships with the code it describes.

features.name: Path visualization
features.evidence: `internal/path`, web hero view; FX-2 operator-bound current hop identity uses `internal/control/pathentities.go` and `web/src/routes/PathPage.tsx`.

features.name: BGP monitoring
features.evidence: `analyzer/`, `internal/bgp`; FX-2 BMP peer observations use `internal/bgp/bmp_entity_evidence.go` with an independent router SVID.

features.name: Alerting
features.evidence: `internal/alert`; silences/acks persist through `migrations/0043_alert_ops.sql`, `internal/store/alertops.go`, `internal/control/alertsactive.go`, `internal/control/alerteval.go`; saved Explorer query extension is preview (`internal/control/alert_query_source.go`, `migrations/0194_alert_query_sources.sql`), with original real-flow and complete surface qualification still owed; dependency configuration metadata is preview (`internal/control/alert_dependency_configuration.go`, `migrations/0195_alert_dependency_policy.sql`, `web/src/routes/AlertDependencyDialog.tsx`), with tenant-bound paged context selection and reversible settings, without notification holding, incident attachment or recovery release

features.name: Dashboards and incident timeline
features.evidence: `internal/incident`, `web/`; dense Operator/Executive dashboards plus tenant-safe saved views and scheduled local-inbox PDF/CSV reporting use `migrations/0061_dashboard_reporting.sql`, `internal/store/dashboardreports.go`, `internal/control/dashboardreporting.go`; FX-2 verified tenant/context/entity correlation uses `migrations/0137_incident_entity_identity.sql` and `internal/control/incidents.go`. Saved-source reporting extension is preview: pinned source recipes, current source/context/credential checks, bounded complete publication and immutable chunk readers use `internal/control/dashboard_report_sources.go`, `internal/control/dashboard_report_generate.go`, `internal/store/report_artifact_read.go` and `migrations/0168_dashboard_report_artifact_chunks.sql` and `migrations/0169_report_output_capacity.sql` (operator-configurable complete output admission); `TestNativeFlowExplorerRealStack` and `TestE2E` declare the service/browser and production-transport acceptance legs. See `docs/dashboard-reporting.md` for finite resource policy and proof provenance. Complete static-document bodies use migrations/0172_static_report_artifact_chunks.sql and the same verified download/lifecycle boundary; the tenant report inbox provides current-authorized keyset pages rather than a retained-history cap.

features.name: eBPF host/L7 agent (L7 preview)
features.evidence: `internal/ebpf` · *kernel-matrix*. Beta L7 is preview: consented TLS-library capture only, metadata redaction by default; no live socket-level cleartext fallback. Full L7 5-tuple/HTTP1 coverage and shipped-stack proof remain incomplete.

features.name: OTel-aligned data model + OTLP
features.evidence: `internal/otel`, `internal/otel/otlp`, `internal/pipeline/otlpexport.go` (metrics/traces/logs ingest/export; three-signal claim pinned by docslint — ARCH-002/003)

features.name: AI RCA + NL query
features.evidence: `internal/ai` · *rca-eval* · `internal/control/ai_flow_question.go` (stateless flow proposals; no stored conversation history)

features.name: Flow analytics
features.evidence: `internal/flow`, `internal/store/flowstore`, `internal/control/explorer_flow.go`, `web/src/routes/NativeFlowPage.tsx` · native registry, builder/charts, saved filters/views, frozen paging/CSV and stateless proposals; `TestNativeFlowExplorerRealStack` binds constructed protocol senders, REST/CLI/MCP and rendered query receipt in the integration profile; CI development transport is distinct from production TLS image proofs. FX-2 exporter identity uses `internal/flow/entity_evidence.go` and the current Explorer pivot. Complete object manifests follow configured object/snapshot bytes and tenant storage charge, with bounded current-owner SQL reads and migrations/0173_flow_snapshot_manifest_capacity.sql; original row/MAC/current-source proofs remain required. Routing capture fields are a preview: fourteen shared registry fields retain original captures under current user/credential/context entities.read and events.read checks, complete paths and distinct unknown ASN predicates. The shared preview peering service has audited REST, exact-JSON CLI, typed clients and native MCP adapters, complete owned-traffic aggregation, exact partial-interval p95 and explicit unknown/observed-gap qualification. Physical joined senders, full public fallback/RPKI/current-authority and served/UI/managed/lifecycle acceptance remain incomplete; component availability is not completed joined-flow qualification. The opt-in local netixlan membership cache supplies complete current ASN/IX/LAN public metadata for the estimate input; it does not establish tenant ownership, a live session or a completed estimate. Capacity measurement is preview: `internal/control/capacity_bill_service.go` and `internal/control/capacity_forecast_service.go` join current tenant/source/receipt authority to exact complete-period bill and trend-weekly forecast adapters. REST, generated clients, CLI, native MCP and `/capacity` UI are implemented. Complete SNMP/current-authority/served/lifecycle/restart and exact-green-main acceptance remain required; component implementation is not a qualified release claim.

features.name: Device telemetry
features.evidence: `internal/device` (SNMP + gNMI); FX-2 SNMP/interface/LLDP identity evidence uses `internal/device/entity_evidence.go` and the operator registry card. FX-2b tenant-scoped NMS switching uses `internal/nmsimport`, `internal/control/nmsimport_export.go`, `web/src/routes/admin/NMSImportCard.tsx` and `TestNMSVendorLiveImportTwoTenants` for live LibreNMS/Zabbix; Orion/PRTG remain documented-export preview pending live trials. Interface-role configuration and the current explanation preview use `internal/control/interface_role_explanation_api.go`, current application-role source snapshots and Admin; Optional complete local PeeringDB IX-prefix generations and current Explorer role dimensions are implemented as preview components; permitted real-source, served/frozen and complete real-router qualification remain unfinished.

features.name: Tenant-defined tags
features.evidence: Preview: tenant-scoped definitions, rules, assignments and reviewed NetBox imports cover owned exporter/interface/prefix/device/agent/test subjects through internal/tags, internal/store/tag_definitions.go, internal/control/tag_definitions.go and internal/control/tag_import_apply.go. Admin, REST, CLI and native MCP surfaces are wired. docs/tenant-tags.md records semantics and proof limits; complete integrated real-sender/current-authority/output acceptance remains required before promotion.
